archivedFailureUnit.causalFailure: The experimental observer was inserted immediately after the refresh-first add child reached add-response-pending, before either provider response was released. The public auth-add child was still waiting at its fake OAuth token-response barrier; the test then waited for its OS flock marker before releasing that add-token response. The pre-existing sequence releases the held refresh response and observes the refresh catalog first, then releases the auth-add token. Consequently the check asked for an auth-add persistence-lock event without evidence that auth-add had progressed past provider token delivery. It deterministically observed no exclusive flock call in that earlier stage. This is a fixture-stage/order failure of the diagnostic; it does not prove that Hermes has no lock, prove a lost update, or establish stale-successful-response rejection.
